title: Lynx and hare

data.source: Annual Canadian lynx trappings 1821 to 1934, Mackenzie River district (Elton and Nicholson 1942), via the R datasets package

prediction: The seed rule with q = 0.5 predicts the height of the next lynx peak (log10) with lower RMSE than both persistence and the running mean of earlier peaks; and the gaps between peaks have CV below 0.2.
baseline: Persistence and the running mean for peak height; Moran's AR(2) model for the yearly numbers.
why: The seed rule beat the last peak but lost to the plain running mean of all earlier peaks, the same result as for sunspots. The rhythm itself is very even, but that was already known and the standard AR(2) model gives it.
